name: two-families-buy
summary: With each family at home, the Langeraks pay 150 simoleons on the server (Household.ModifyFamilyFunds, the funnel buy mode pays through): both clients read the server's funds for both families. Funds ride the per-Sim details channel (SimDetailsWire, APPLY_SIM_DETAILS) of the claimed Sims, so a family reaches the clients while a player is on one of its Sims (first run 20261021-225010: 4134 to 3984 on all three games)
